title: The Broken Cycle
description: The dead are rising near Willow Dale, Crossroads, and the outskirts of Thornfield, and the Dalhurst priest of Morthane has already lost two lay brothers sent out to bury the ones who fall in the first waves - young men who volunteered for grave duty and did not come back from it. He believes something in Willow Dale's lowest chambers is disrupting the cycle itself, and he asks you to finish what cost him two of his own before it costs a third.

objectives.description: Descend into Willow Dale's deepest chambers
Find the source of the undead corruption
Defeat the Undead Lord that killed two of the priest's own
Cleanse the corrupted altar with Morthane's blessing
Return to Priest of Morthane with news of victory

notes: Threat: named against the audit's complaint - two lay brothers of the Dalhurst temple already died on grave duty in this incursion, giving the region-wide rising a concrete cost before the player is asked to finish it. Giver motive: this is personal loss for the priest, not abstract doctrine. Consequence: not wired.
